assertions.name: isospin_pair_decomposition_dims
assertions.source: I=1/2 (x) I=1/2 = I=1 + I=0 with dims 3 + 1 = 4 = 2x2. The nucleon pair flavor space decomposes canonically, with I=1 exchange-symmetric and I=0 exchange-antisymmetric.

assertions.name: W_charge_symmetric_between_pp_and_nn
assertions.source: THE FALSIFIABLE CONSEQUENCE. pp and nn both sit in the I=1 triplet, so the selection rule forces the same color weighting (the T1 system: 0 on same-color pairs, 1/6 on each different-color pair) on both. W therefore cannot distinguish pp from nn — charge symmetry is a CONSEQUENCE of the rule, not an imposed constraint. Would be false if the rule permitted pp and nn to draw on different color summands.

description: Bean qou-63n2, the flavor side of the color-tube weight tensor W, continuing qou-ctkw / PR #4506 (which settled the color side: T1 (x) T1 = A + T1 + H with forced Sym^2/Alt^2 grading, narrowing W from 8 free parameters to 2). Observation: flavor is a representation too — a nucleon pair carries I=1/2 (x) I=1/2 = I=1 (sym, dim 3) + I=0 (alt, dim 1). CONDITIONAL selection rule (hypothesis named, not hidden): IF the interface carries definite antisymmetry under simultaneous exchange of color-sheet and flavor labels, only color-Sym(A+H) x flavor-Alt(I=0) and color-Alt(T1) x flavor-Sym(I=1) survive. FALSIFIABLE CONSEQUENCE: pp and nn are both I=1, so W is forced to be CHARGE-SYMMETRIC between them — the weight tensor cannot distinguish pp from nn. That is exactly what the corpus CSB analysis demands (the production sigma/sigma^-1 assignment over-breaks charge symmetry by ~78%, ~570x the substrate p/n split; the gg-production probe collapses it to 0 under the flavor-blind average). The rule is fixed by representation theory BEFORE the comparison, so the agreement is a post-hoc check, not an input. Parameter count 8 -> 2 (color) -> 1 (this rule). OPEN: the remaining A/H mix in the I=0 deuteron channel is NOT closed; choosing it to match a target would be a fit. CONDITIONAL narrowing, not a closure; nothing wired; no target consulted.
